meta: Concept site for Bluejay Plumbing Co., a made-up Dayton, Ohio plumber: leak repair, drain cleaning, water heaters and sump pumps at flat prices. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.title: Leaks fixed. Drains cleared. Today.
hero.sub: Repairs, water heaters and drain cleaning across the Miami Valley. A real person answers, and you get the price before we pick up a wrench.
facts: Shoe covers and a clean worksite

picker.title: What's going on?
picker.note: Tap the closest match. It fills in the form for you, so we know what to bring.

services_title: The jobs we do every day.
services: Under the sink, behind the wall or in the ceiling. Found, fixed and dried out.
Kitchen, bath and main lines, cleared with a snake or a hydro jet.
Tank and tankless, repaired or replaced, usually the same day.
Running toilets, dripping faucets and new fixtures installed right.
Repairs, replacements and battery backups, before the spring rains.
We see what's in the line before anyone digs.
steps: Call, text or tap a problem above. We give you a time window that day.
The plumber looks, then quotes one price for the whole job before starting.
Shoe covers on, drop cloths down, mess gone when we leave.

hero.alt: A bright farmhouse kitchen with a white apron sink and tall faucet under a bay window.

g1.alt: Ends of stacked teal plastic drainage pipes in rows.

g2.alt: A chrome pull-down kitchen faucet over a steel sink.

area.title: Dayton and the Miami Valley.
area.note: Most calls in these towns get a plumber the same day.

about.title: A small crew that picks up the phone.
body: Call most plumbing companies and you get a call center, a four-hour window and a price you find out about later.
Call us and you talk to someone in Dayton who can tell you when a plumber will be there and roughly what it'll cost.

promise.title: The price we quote is the price you pay.
promise.body: One flat price for the whole job, agreed before we start. If it takes us longer than we thought, that's on us, not you.

faq: Do you charge by the hour?
No. You get one flat price for the job before any work starts, so you're never watching the clock.
Usually. Call before noon and most jobs in Dayton and nearby get a plumber the same day.
Should I get a tank or tankless water heater?
Tank costs less up front. Tankless costs more but saves space and runs longer. We'll price both for your house.
Why does my sump pump matter so much?
In Ohio basements it's the only thing between spring rain and a flooded floor. A battery backup keeps it running when the power goes out.
Yes. Shoe covers, drop cloths and a full cleanup are part of every job.

form.title: Tell us what's wrong.
form.note: A real person reads every request and calls back within 30 minutes during business hours.
